question: Where can I find a hospital that fall inside a 90 kilometers boundary to the southwest of Hasley Canyon Equestrian Center, Valencia, CA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'hospital' AND ST_DWithin( pois.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hasley Canyon Equestrian Center%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 90000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hasley Canyon Equestrian Center%' LIMIT 1 ), pois.geometry ) ) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
